result:
All five changes are in and `dotnet build` succeeds with 0 warnings and 0 errors. I only built it. I didn't open Grasshopper or test the components or any saved file.

- **Panel Stats:** it has a new "Min Area" number input (default 0) after "Panels", and panels with a smaller area are left out of the statistics. If every panel is below the minimum, the component shows an error.
- **Planarity:** it has a new "Max Deviation" output after "Flat Count". It is 0 when there are no panels.
- **Tolerance of 0 or less:** Planarity, Classify Panels and Group Identical Panels now show "Tolerance must be greater than 0." and output nothing.
- **Group Identical Panels:** it runs in the background through a `Task`, takes a cancellation token so it stops when the inputs change, and reports progress as a percentage. It follows the same pattern as Nest On Sheets. The Tolerance check happens before the background task starts.
- **Classify Panels:** the output "Type" is now "Class". It keeps the same position.

Saved files should still open with every component in place. I didn't rename any method or type, so the component GUIDs are unchanged. The new input and output were added after the existing ones, and the rename only changes a label, not the position.

The changes are in `Facade\IFacadePack.cs` and `Facade\FacadePack.cs`.
